name: Back Points For Bella
about:
Date: Sunday, November 22nd, 2026
Location: Baldwin High School - 4653 Clairton Blvd, Pittsburgh, PA 15236
Details: Tournament will be run on FloArena

Time: NOVICE: 9am | OPEN: 1pm
Entry Fee: $35.00 per wrestler - Online Only NO REFUNDS. Double entries permitted.
Rules: PIAA modified rules. Bout times are: 1 – 1 – 1 minute periods, PIAA overtime. (1 minute OT/30 seconds ride-out). Madison Weight divisions. Brackets will be determined at tournament director’s discretion. Referee’s and Tournament Directors decisions are final. 

Weigh-In: Baldwin High School - 4653 Clairton Blvd, Pittsburgh, PA 15236 (Weigh-in in singlet) 
Saturday, November 21st, 730p-9p (All Divisions)
Sunday, November 22nd, 7a-8a (Novice) | 11a-12p (Open)
                                     
Admissions: Adults: $10.00 (including coaches) | Kids: FREE 
Concessions: Available all day! 
Eligibility: Age as of NOVEMBER 22nd, 2026. Proof will be required if age is challenged. Challenger must provide, as well.
